messages:
Mira (CSM): FYI — saw 4 midmarket accounts drop into 'at-risk' this week, usage down ~40% on core API. Putting a lightweight triage and outreach plan here.
Sam (AM): thanks. quick ask — can we keep the outreach short and offer a low-friction win first?
Mira (CSM): Exactly. Proposed sequence: 1) 24h quick check-in msg, 2) 72h targeted enablement workshop, 3) 1-week tailored remediation + one-time onboarding credit. If no response after 10 days -> escalation to renewal team.
Ari (Onboarding): can you paste the 24h message? i'll make a calendar template.
Mira (CSM): paste below — feel free to tweak: 
```
Hi {{first_name}}, quick check — we noticed API calls for {{product}} are down. Any blockers we can help with? 15–30m sync available this week to walk through metrics and quick fixes. — Mira
```
Diego (CS): i'll own Brightly Corp (usage drop matches their new release). Booked sync Wed 10am PST.
triage-bot: automated note — renewal_flag set for 3 accounts (Brightly, Modu, Zephyr); please review in 72h :alarm_clock:
Mira (CSM): Ownership plan: Brightly -> Diego; Modu -> Ari; Zephyr -> Sam. Add to Gainsight and tag renewal team.
Sam (AM): On incentives — recommend one-time onboarding credit + 2 weeks priority support rather than ongoing discounts. lowers long-term expectations.
Ari (Onboarding): also plan a 45m targeted workshop covering prompts, batching, and basic troubleshooting; i'll prepare a 10-slide deck and an ops checklist.
Kevin-eng: i can join Brightly call to look at routing/latency. preliminary guess: enable prefix cache + bump KV cache, will validate with logs.
Diego (CS): i'll surface logs and a small prompt set in the call. can we get a short runbook for eng to follow during the meeting?
Mira (CSM): yes — outline for eng during sync: 1) repro steps, 2) tail logs (last 30m), 3) quick perf toggles (prefix cache, batch size), 4) note follow-ups.
Sam (AM): i'll prepare a one-off credit approval (legal/finance ok) and add notes to the renewal tracker.
triage-bot: reminder scheduled — follow-up check in 72 hours if no reply.
Mira (CSM): next steps for team: outreach by EOD, schedule workshop invites, attach agenda + prompt set, add all notes to Gainsight. if no reply within 72h escalate to renewal ops.
Ari (Onboarding): will run a quick eval on customer prompt quality before the call and flag any model mismatch.
Kevin-eng: marked — i'll be on Wed. if we see model fallback to cheaper variant during peak, i'll recommend pinning to stable variant for the short term.
Diego (CS): thanks, will share meeting notes and action items after the call.
Mira (CSM): after calls please write a 1-paragraph internal summary and any play updates — want to refine the checklist based on outcomes. :thumbsup:
Sam (AM): great — appreciate the quick coord team.
